Involvement that fits

The right contribution for the work you want to undertake.

You may need advice on a decision, help developing customers or partners, coordination across organizations, or participation in creating something together.

Together, we define our contribution, responsibilities and boundaries. Any change in role or scope is agreed separately.

What this means for you

Involvement suited to your situation, with clarity about what SetuHashi will undertake and what remains with you and other participants.
